newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GLOBUS DIV PAYMENTS TO START ON MAY 26.
newsitem.headline: GLOBUS DIV PAYMENTS TO START ON MAY 26.

text.p: Hungarian canned food company Globus Konzervipari Rt said on Tuesday that it will start dividend payments on May 26.
The company, which held its annual shareholders meeting last Friday, will pay a 12 percent dividend or 120 forints per share, on its 1996 earnings, as against eight percent on its 1995 earnings.
